MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 121
   C. 11
   D. 122

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 5

4. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

5. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.205

6. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

7. Solve for x: x + 3 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 5
   C. 8
   D. 6

8. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

10. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

11. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

12. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 7
   C. 6
   D. 18

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 22
   C. 30
   D. 105

14. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 2

15. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

16. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 32

17. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 56
   C. 1
   D. 15

18. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

19. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 22
   C. 18
   D. 77

20. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 13

21. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

22. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/2

23. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 7

24. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

25. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 42

26. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 5

27. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 33

28. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

29. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

30. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
